nodes.label: DrawInspector per-component inspector
nodes.rationale: Each editable component gets one DrawInspector next to its Serializer<T>, not a generic reflection system.

nodes.label: IRenderer::GetNativeHandle (raw SDL_Renderer* leak)
nodes.rationale: The one sanctioned leak through IRenderer, needed because ImGui's SDL3 renderer backend binds SDL_Renderer directly.

nodes.label: ASGE Level Editor Build Roadmap
nodes.rationale: No speculative abstraction; editor edits a real Registry and saves via same Serializer<T>/SceneManager path as the game, no parallel schema or renderer.

nodes.label: No serialization/reflection in ECS Phase 1

nodes.label: TEST_F Fixture + Temp Path Convention
nodes.rationale: Temp path keyed on this pointer so parallel test instances don't collide; TearDown uses error_code overloads.

nodes.label: Milestone Title Convention (0.<N>.0 - Title Phase P)
nodes.norm_label: milestone title convention (0.<n>.0 - title phase p)

nodes.label: Declaration-site Doxygen Comments
nodes.rationale: One short @brief block on the header declaration, 4-6 lines; fields get trailing // comments; no narrative comments inside bodies since rationale belongs in commit messages.

nodes.label: One Test per Error Enum Value
nodes.norm_label: one test per error enum value
nodes.rationale: Every Result<T>/BoolResult method needs success path plus a test for each distinct error value, asserting the specific error code.

nodes.label: Verify: Build and Run Tests
nodes.rationale: Tests must be built and run; failing tests reveal real defects (e.g. VFS dangling string_view and off-by-one substr bugs) so never loosen assertions.

nodes.label: Red-then-Green Regression Test
nodes.rationale: A fix without a failing-then-passing regression test run isn't done.

nodes.label: Release Notes Altitude Rule
nodes.rationale: Release notes answer 'what can I now do with ASGE and why care', cutting internal refactors, same-release bug narration, CI/roadmap-only commits.

nodes.label: Branch as Text Line, Not Native Link
nodes.norm_label: branch as text line, not native link
nodes.rationale: createLinkedBranch silently no-ops on an existing branch; no API attaches one shared branch to many issues.

nodes.label: Comprehensive Engine Manual
nodes.rationale: Deferred until Tier 1-3 systems land and stabilize; documenting a still-changing engine produces stale docs faster than they can be maintained.

nodes.label: Dedicated (non-P2P) Servers
nodes.rationale: Speculative; only revisited if multiplayer becomes an actual goal.

nodes.label: Rollback Netcode
nodes.rationale: Genre-specific (fighting games, competitive action); only worth it if the engine targets such games.

nodes.label: Action Map & Rebinding
nodes.rationale: Deferred until gamepad provides a second physical input scheme; building against a single WASD scheme would be guessing at requirements.

nodes.label: Gamepad Support
nodes.rationale: Separate SDL subsystem (SDL_gamepad.h) with its own connect/disconnect lifecycle, not an extension of keyboard/mouse event shapes.

nodes.label: Client/Server Architecture
nodes.rationale: Entire system speculative; only built if multiplayer becomes an actual goal (MVP is single-player).

nodes.label: Touch Input
nodes.rationale: Unscoped until a touch-capable platform joins the Windows/Linux/macOS target list.

nodes.label: Parallel System Execution
nodes.rationale: Needs systems to declare component read/write so a scheduler can run non-conflicting ones concurrently; meaningless with only MovementSystem/RenderSystem.

nodes.label: Async Asset Loading
nodes.rationale: Decode off the main thread using the existing ThreadPool, avoiding a second thread pool; returns future/promise-shaped handle.

nodes.label: Music Streaming
nodes.rationale: Incremental decode to avoid blocking the main loop; likely shares Asset Pipeline Phase 2's ThreadPool approach.

nodes.label: ThreadPool as Shared Job System
nodes.rationale: Use existing ThreadPool for engine workloads rather than each subsystem building its own.

nodes.label: asge-editor Executable Target
nodes.rationale: Windows .exe icon via resource compiler (.rc) since no cross-platform equivalent; runtime window icon set via SDL_SetWindowIcon from assets/icon.png.

nodes.label: Synthetic Audio Assets (blip.ogg, ambient.ogg)
nodes.rationale: Generated synthetically with numpy/soundfile (not third-party content); ambient hum has fades so looping does not click.

nodes.label: Game Event Bus
nodes.rationale: Build on Signal rather than reinventing dispatch; Signal already solves thread safety and automatic disconnection.

nodes.label: Spatial Audio
nodes.rationale: Needs a listener position, naturally the entity holding the Rendering Phase 1 camera.

nodes.label: SDL_GPU Decision Gate
nodes.rationale: Revisit SDL_GPU only when a concrete feature needs custom shading fixed-function compositing can't cover; never opening is a valid outcome.

nodes.label: DSP Effects & Reverb Zones
nodes.rationale: Mixing polish on top of Phase 2 spatial audio; unscoped until a concrete audio-design need.

nodes.label: Additive Scene Loading
nodes.rationale: Foundation already in SceneManager (per-entity SceneId, shared Registry); only lifting ActiveEntities() single-SceneId restriction remains.

nodes.label: Prefabs
nodes.rationale: Template over Phase 1's scene format with per-instance overrides, not a separate concept.

nodes.label: World Streaming
nodes.rationale: Unscoped until additive loading is in real use and a world outgrows memory.

nodes.label: docs/gh-pages-site Branch
nodes.rationale: Docs-site fixes accumulate on this branch and are PR'd into main only in a batch on the owner's explicit go-ahead; docs.yml deploys only on push to main so staged fixes intentionally don't go live.

nodes.label: FileDialogResult / DrainFileDialogResult
nodes.rationale: Native SDL file dialog callbacks may run on another thread; hand results off through this rather than a new mutex round trip.

nodes.label: components::SerializableComponents
nodes.rationale: The one fixed tuple of serializable component types walked by the scene (de)serializer and editor folds; add new components here, never a second list.

nodes.label: Batched Docs PR Policy
nodes.rationale: Prevents one-off fix/ branches off main for docs changes; report and stop instead of opening a PR.

nodes.label: Local Doxygen Rebuild + Headless Chrome Check
nodes.norm_label: local doxygen rebuild + headless chrome check
nodes.rationale: Use portable doxygen/dot binary and headless Chrome screenshot; no Docker/VM needed.

nodes.label: Commit/Push Only on Explicit Request
nodes.rationale: Never commit proactively; split commits into engine, editor, and docs with narrative bodies.

nodes.label: Launch Then Stop (No Automated UI Driving)
nodes.norm_label: launch then stop (no automated ui driving)
nodes.rationale: Automated synthetic-input/screenshot verification loop is explicitly unwanted; wait for user feedback.

nodes.label: Editor Has No Game/IGameState Dependency
nodes.rationale: Application is templated on TGame and unusable here; the editor drives its own raw SDL event loop against VideoSystem.

nodes.label: No Speculative Abstraction
nodes.rationale: Prove the narrow case before generalizing; a new editable component is one DrawInspector free function next to its Serializer<T> specialization, not a reflection system.

nodes.label: One Phase at a Time Scope Discipline
nodes.norm_label: one phase at a time scope discipline
nodes.rationale: Never silently move to the next phase; stop so the user can review/test.

nodes.label: ASGE Design Pillars (Performance, Simplicity, Extensibility, Tooling)
nodes.norm_label: asge design pillars (performance, simplicity, extensibility, tooling)
nodes.rationale: Thin SDL3 abstractions, composable subsystems via ASGE.hpp umbrella header, ECS + signal system for decoupling, and debug/profiling tooling.

nodes.label: Native Scripting
nodes.rationale: Script component invoking a plain C++ function/functor, not a bytecode VM or reflection system.

nodes.label: Managed Scripting
nodes.rationale: Language choice (Lua vs C#/Python) left open until native Script component limitations are concrete.

nodes.label: Runtime Script Reload
nodes.rationale: Depends on the chosen embedding supporting it cleanly; constrains language choice.

nodes.label: Broad-phase collision detection
nodes.rationale: Most likely to bite silently: scenes just get slower as colliding entities grow.

nodes.label: Retained-Mode UI
nodes.rationale: Persistent widget objects likely composed of ECS entities+components rather than a bespoke widget hierarchy; only once gameplay needs UI outliving a frame.

nodes.label: Common asset-handle / Path->Result<T> loader pattern
nodes.rationale: Unify Image::Load/Font::Load before a third (audio) loader triplicates the pattern.

nodes.label: AudioSystem over AudioSource components (SDL_audio)
nodes.rationale: A system, not a singleton AudioManager; SDL_audio avoids another third-party dependency.

nodes.label: Windows SDL3 DLL post-build copy pattern
nodes.norm_label: windows sdl3 dll post-build copy pattern
nodes.rationale: On Windows, each test executable copies SDL3.dll next to itself so the test binary can load SDL at runtime.

nodes.label: Archetype/Chunked Storage
nodes.rationale: Data-layout optimization over Phase 1's sparse-set store for cache locality; only adopted once 13-Optimization profiling shows storage is a bottleneck.

nodes.label: Path-Keyed Asset Cache
nodes.rationale: Second reference to the same path returns the loaded value instead of re-decoding. Task marked done.

nodes.label: GPU Frame-Time Profiling
nodes.rationale: Only matters once SDLRenderer draw calls are complex enough for GPU time to bottleneck.

nodes.label: Beginner Tutorials
nodes.rationale: Written once examples/systems are stable so tutorials don't go stale.

nodes.label: Asset Live Reload
nodes.rationale: Reuses the config hot-reload FileWatcher+Signal pattern, invalidating Phase 2's cache instead of config values.

nodes.label: ECS Cache Optimization
nodes.rationale: Is 03-ECS Phase 2's archetype storage; this doc is the 'why now' trigger once profiling data exists.
